### Policy-side gap found by the scan (not a KB defect)
- **PS-1** — the restoration tool's `charge_period_start` / `charge_period_end` ("the first and last day of training the restoration covers") are bound by no source sentence or compute line of P-RST (`compute` yields only `days`). The KB carries every source sentence that touches them (hub "the days given back, the first and last day of training they cover"; "whose term start and term end are carried on the amendment"; 7.01 "The days a restoration covers depend on the last date of attendance and on how far the term's own charge reached"; 7.03(a) "the days through the last date of attendance are restored at the difference …"). Task 1's GT start (2026-02-18 = LDA + 1) rests on reading "covered" as "given back at a positive difference"; with a positive through-LDA difference the same words would yield the term start. The KB may not close a boundary the source leaves open, so this is recorded against the policy layer. It caused the KB-RUNTIME RED (policy-side origin) in runtime_context/…/1.md.
